Name: Maren the Lorekeeper
Dialogue: Every technique in these pages was paid for in blood. Yours costs gold — a bargain.
Seventy-five gold and a steady hand. The forest teaches the rest.
I taught the last group everything I know. Lovely people. Terrible reflexes.
Knowledge keeps better than bread and sells better than both.
The Gravelord? Oh, he was a student once. Poor listener.
Learn it here, or learn it out there the hard way. Here's cheaper.
